title: ParcelFlow
highlights: Idempotent ELT pipeline ingesting 695K synthetic shipment rows across 731 daily partitions and 15 hubs into a star-schema warehouse.
14-day SARIMA forecaster that beat a seasonal-naive baseline by ~16% MAPE (14.1% vs 16.8%).
Data-quality stage quarantining 16,081 bad rows (2.3%) with reasons, plus a run log for observability.
